label: Contrapunctus 9
title: The Art of Fugue, Contrapunctus 9, double fugue at the twelfth

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a fourth every bar. Tenor: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Returns in Link (bar 44). Returns in Link (bar 98).
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Soprano); Subject in D minor (Tenor)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 29–34) in part, with the alto's line in the tenor, the bass's line in the soprano, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times). Tenor: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 53–58). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 81–88).
sections.leads: From D minor to F major

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Tenor); Subject in F major (Alto)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 44) in part, with soprano and tenor exchanged, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject (5 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from subject 2, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Tenor: a figure from subject 2 (2 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a third every bar.
sections.leads: From F major to D minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Alto); Subject in D minor (Bass)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence rising by a seventh every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from subject 2, inverted (3 times), in a sequence falling by a fifth every bar.
sections.leads: From D minor to A minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Tenor); Subject in A minor (Alto)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 44) in part, with soprano and tenor exchanged, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Bass); Subject in D minor (Soprano)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 29–34), with the alto's line in the tenor, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 108–118).
sections.leads: From D minor to G minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Tenor); Subject in G minor (Alto)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 98), with the tenor's line in the alto, a fifth higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Tenor: a figure from subject 2, inverted and a figure from the subject and a figure from subject 2 and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from subject 2 and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every bar.
sections.leads: From G minor to D minor; perfect cadence in G minor at bar 112

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Alto); Subject in D minor (Tenor)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from subject 2, inverted.
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in D minor at bar 130
